'''Ben Johnson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Minneapolis tournament (19 December)]] on 19 December 2000 with [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|RST]], according to Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1564">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-21-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1564/ mirkwood-deadbody-style], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 21 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-21-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1564/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
